items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I was so anxious, I was so glad to hear Doc Seuss singing Mark Korky. I hadn't even remembered that. He sang it very well.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I'll just ask you some questions off the top of my head.
